allow_instructions: This folder is a Yap Studio video workspace. The yap-studio command is expected here. It writes to ~/Library/Application Support/yap-studio and ~/Library/Caches/yap-studio, downloads the renderer and speech model, starts a local page on this Mac and reads the Photos album or media folder the creator names.
block_instructions: Ask before running python3 setup.py or python3 new_project.py because the agent can edit these files.
Ask before any command that deletes, moves or renames anything in inbox/.
